description: Apply an effect to layers (Effect menu) by match name (e.g. "ADBE Gaussian Blur 2") or display name, optionally setting its properties by name, e.g. { "Blurriness": 20 }

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

properties.description: Property display names to values (numbers, arrays, booleans)

name: apply_effect
title: Apply Effect
